papers.title: CapProbe: Evaluating Detailed Image Captions via Full-Scene Dense Question Answering
papers.authors: Mouxiao Huang, Qiangyu Yan, Borui Jiang, Han Shu
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, Segment Anything, image captioning
papers.affiliations: Huawei Technologies
papers.intro: CapProbe通过将每张图像分解为语义区域并为每个区域生成密集多选题，构建了一个全场景密集QA基准，从而把详细图像描述评估转化为区域对齐的事实核查，解决了传统和LLM打分方法难以验证细粒度事实的问题。

papers.title: Entropy-Centric Explainable AI for Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Ali Saleh, Abdul Karim Gizzini, Mohamad Ghassany, Ali J. Ghandour
papers.affiliations: 黎巴嫩大学工程学院（Lebanese University）；巴黎东克雷泰伊大学（UPEC）LISSI/TincNET实验室；EFREI研究实验室；国家遥感中心（CNRS，黎巴嫩）
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于熵（Entropy）不确定性的采样型XAI方法"Entropy-Centric"，通过扰动输入图像并分析目标对象预测熵的变化来生成语义分割的解释热力图，同时提出高显著性影响测试（H-SIT）评估方法，以更有效地验证解释区域的真正相关性。

papers.title: R4DSG: Relative 4D Scene Graph Memory for Object-Centric Question Answering in Long Egocentric Video
papers.authors: Ke Ma, Yamin Mao, Weiming Li, Shuai Tan, Yijie Zhong, Hao Chen, Haofen Wang, Meng Wang
papers.tags: video segmentation, tracking, scene understanding, visual question answering, video search
papers.affiliations: Tongji University; Samsung R&D Institute China - Beijing; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Samsung Research America
papers.intro: R4DSG提出了一种基于"相对4D场景图记忆"的方法，将长期自我中心RGB视频转换为以静态锚点和动态物体为核心的可查询记忆条目，从而在不依赖全局坐标系或强几何输入的前提下支持物体中心的长期问答。

papers.title: StreamFlow: Dynamic Memory Flows for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.authors: Muxin Fu, Yifan Zhang, Wentao Zhang, Fangming Guo, Qian Chen, Guibin Zhang, Shuicheng Yan, Bo An
papers.affiliations: Tongji University; Nanyang Technological University; University of Michigan; The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; National University of Singapore
papers.intro: StreamFlow 提出了一种高效、冻结骨干的视觉记忆框架，通过“动态感知中期记忆 + 潜在长期记忆 + 注意力引导注入”实现对历史视觉信息的按需访问，在流式视频理解上取得当前最优性能，同时显著提升视觉接地性和推理效率。

papers.title: Multimodal Model Diffing for Feature Discovery and Control
papers.authors: Hunar Batra, Lachin Naghashyar, Ashkan Khakzar, Philip Torr, Christian Schroeder de Witt, Constantin Venhoff, Ronald Clark
papers.affiliations: University of Oxford（作者1、3、4、5、6、7），Microsoft（作者2共同所属）
papers.intro: 本文提出MMDiff，一个多模态模型对账框架，通过训练多模态稀疏自编码器并将基础语言模型SAE与多模态适应后的SAE进行对比差分，识别被多模态训练改变的特征，进而实现特征级因果移除与引导控制。

papers.title: Learning How the World Evolves: Extrapolative Video World Models via Latent Dynamics Reasoning
papers.authors: Haodong Li, Shaoteng Liu, Tianyu Wang, Chongjian Ge, Sihui Ji, Jiahan Zhang, Xin Lin, Haolin Lu, Zhe Lin, Manmohan Chandraker
papers.affiliations: UCSD（加州大学圣地亚哥分校）、Adobe
papers.intro: 本文提出Latent Dynamics Reasoning（LDR），一种通过结构化潜空间中的显式运动学积分来推理潜在动力学而非直接回归未来帧的视频世界模型，首次实现在超出训练分布的条件下外推所学动力学。

papers.title: Beyond Hazard Resemblance: Contrastive Event Adjudication for Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Wenti Yin, Xiang Wang, Huaxin Zhang, Hanqing Wang, Hongbo Shao, Changxin Gao, Nong Sang
papers.affiliations: 华中科技大学（人工智能与自动化学院，图像处理与智能控制重点实验室）
papers.intro: CEAVAD提出了一种训练免费的视频异常检测方法，通过将推理单元从孤立的异常概念转变为可证伪的事件假设，并利用危险–良性对比事件与冻结的视觉-语言编码器和多模态大模型进行推理时对比裁决，建立起可修正的解释性异常判定边界，实现时间定位和证据化解释。

papers.title: Sci-VBench: Evaluating Knowledge- and Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation in Science Domains
papers.authors: Diandian Zhang, Tingyu Song, Lin Fu, Zheyuan Yang, Yilun Zhao
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学（Zhejiang University）、中国科学院大学（UCAS）、同济大学（Tongji University）、耶鲁大学（Yale University）
papers.intro: Sci-VBench是一个覆盖60个学科、包含1,253个专家注释示例的科学领域知识推理密集型视频生成基准，通过可复用的rubric评估协议，系统评测了16个前沿文本到视频模型，揭示了专有与开源模型在科学因果正确性上的显著差距。

papers.title: RynnValue: Scaling Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance
papers.authors: Dongchi Huang, Hongyin Zhang, Bohan Hou, Siteng Huang, Zhian Su, Hang Guo, Tong Lu, Zhaofeng Xu, Jiahao Tang, Jianfei Yang, Donglin Wang, Peixi Peng, Mingxiu Chen, Deli Zhao, Xin Li
papers.affiliations: DAMO Academy, Alibaba Group; Hupan Lab
papers.intro: RynnValue提出以“时间距离”（从当前观测到语言指定目标的定向代价）替代偏好/进度类监督目标，训练一个开源的语言条件机器人价值基础模型，通过预测绝对/相对时间距离来提供奖励接口，并在跨任务、跨具身、跨视角的轨迹排序和真实世界策略学习中超越偏好监督方法。

papers.title: MedPixel: A Unified Pixel-Language Model for Medical Reasoning and Segmentation
papers.authors: Haoyu Yang, Meixing Shi, Zengjie Chen, Haoran Sun, Haitao Leng, Xiaoming Shi, Yuxiang Cai, Yankai Jiang
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University, Fudan University, Kuaishou, East China Normal University, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
papers.intro: MedPixel是一个统一的医学像素-语言模型，基于共享的语言-掩码接口，通过构建约44万规模的MedPLG-440K像素-语言数据集和两阶段训练（多任务SFT + 像素级偏好优化PLPO），实现了指代分割、推理分割、交互式分割、可解释分割和医学VQA五种任务的统一处理。

papers.title: KGCaRe: Explainable Complex Conditional Question Answering using Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction and Context Retrieval with LLMs
papers.authors: Ghanshyam Verma, Simanta Sarkar, Devishree Pillai, Hotaka Shiokawa, Yourong Xu, Fiona Veazey, Peter Hubbert, Hui Su, Paul Buitelaar
papers.affiliations: University of Galway（Insight Research Ireland Centre for Data Analytics, Data Science Institute）；Fidelity Investments（Boston, Massachusetts, USA；Dublin, Co. Dublin, Ireland）
papers.intro: KGCaRe是一种结合LLM自动构建知识图谱与向量语义检索的混合方法，通过迭代式图遍历和提示词融合结构化与非结构化上下文，实现复杂条件问答的准确、可解释推理。

papers.title: REFRAMED: Towards Realistic Audio Description Generation for Movies
papers.authors: Igor Sterner, Mirella Lapata, Alex Lascarides, Frank Keller
papers.tags: multimodal learning, scene understanding, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: School of Informatics, University of Edinburgh, United Kingdom
papers.intro: 本文重新定义了音频描述生成任务，要求模型联合决策“描述什么”和“何时描述”，并构建了高质量的电影AD数据集REFramed和配套基准，系统评估了现有AD系统与多模态大语言模型的性能。

papers.title: HandSplatter: Automated Digital Goniometry from Neural Rendering
papers.authors: Emmett Chen, Neal Chen, Xiang Li, Quanzheng Li, Siyeop Yoon
papers.affiliations: Massachusetts General Hospital
papers.intro: 本文提出一种名为HandSplatter的自动化数字测角流水线，通过高斯泼溅神经渲染重建手部三维点云，结合2D特征提取与离散密度爬山算法，实现高精度的手部关节定位和角度测量，以替代传统手动角度计。

papers.title: LookAgain: Closed-Loop GUI Grounding with Visually Grounded Reflection
papers.authors: Renshan Zhang, Haoyang Meng, Yixiao He, Rui Shao, April Hua Liu, Liqiang Nie
papers.affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen; Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; Shenzhen Loop Area Institute; Shanghai University of Finance and Economics
papers.intro: 论文提出LookAgain，一种由“视觉接地反思”驱动的闭环GUI接地球器，将接地从一次性坐标回归重构为多轮“预测–再看–精修”过程，并通过SFT+GRPO两阶段训练实现。

papers.title: Diffuse the object, keep its label: curating detector training data from a few unlabeled photographs via VLM-built 3D vegetation scenes
papers.authors: Mario Malizia, Marnix Enting, Rob Haelterman, Ken Hasselmann
papers.tags: object detection, diffusion model, image generation
papers.affiliations: Royal Military Academy, Brussels, Belgium; KU Leuven, Leuven, Belgium; Flanders Make, Heverlee, Belgium
papers.intro: 论文提出一种从少量未标注现场照片合成带标签检测训练数据的流水线：用VLM生成粗略3D植被场景，在其中放置3D物体网格获得精确标签，再通过LoRA微调的扩散模型进行背景重纹理，并用分级掩膜锁定（mask-lock）保护物体区域，从而在不依赖跨场地标注数据的前提下训练出可匹配或超越真实数据训练的检测器。

papers.title: Thinking With Tools, Not With Pixels: Tool Calls as Text Scaffolds for Visual Reasoning
papers.authors: Jiahao Shao, Yuanbo Yang, Yiyi Liao, Yujun Shen, Ceyuan Yang, Yinghao Xu
papers.affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Ant Group, Zhejiang University
papers.intro: 论文提出 TextCall（call-but-no-return）干预，在训练和推理时保留工具调用的结构化文本脚手架（工具名、坐标、目标描述、意图）但将返回图像替换为固定文本占位符，从而证明在当前 thinking-with-images 分布下，负载信号是工具调用时发出的文本脚手架而非返回的像素。

papers.title: You Only Flow Once: Calibrated and Real-Time Radar Pose Estimation with Multi-Hypothesis Normalizing Flows
papers.authors: Jonas Leo Mueller, Sebastian Hoefler, Dario Zanca, Naga Venkata Sai Jitin Jami, Thomas Altstidl, Bjoern M. Eskofier
papers.affiliations: Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg; Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML); LMU München; Helmholtz Zentrum München
papers.intro: 本文提出MH-NFPG，利用条件归一化流将雷达点云映射为校准的多假设3D姿态分布，通过单次前向传播实现实时推理，并在精度和校准上超越扩散模型。

papers.title: A Height-Constrained 2-Point Minimal Solver for Pose Estimation from Active LED Markers with Event Cameras
papers.authors: Runze Yuan, Alexander Kappler, Jun Zhang, Kuangyi Chen, Fabio Morbidi, Pascal Vasseur, Cédric Demonceaux, Friedrich Fraundorfer
papers.affiliations: Graz University of Technology（Institute of Visual Computing）；University of Picardie Jules Verne（MIS laboratory）；University of Burgundy Europe（ICB laboratory）
papers.intro: 本文推导了一种仅利用两个LED标记点、结合已知倾斜角和相机高度的最小位姿求解器（高度约束P2P），通过闭式解和线性最小二乘两种方式唯一确定相机位姿，并在合成和真实数据上验证了其相对于现有P2P/P3P方法的优越性。

papers.title: CableDex: Cable Length Estimation on Industrial Reels Using a Handheld Device
papers.authors: Francisco Guillén, Ricardo Almeida, Bruno Silva, João C. Neves
papers.affiliations: Francisco Guillén - University of Beira Interior, NOVA-LINCS UBI, Portugal Bruno M. C. Silva - University of Beira Interior, IT - Instituto de Telecomunicações, Portugal João Neves - University of Beira Interior, NOVA-LINCS UBI, Portugal
papers.intro: CableDex是一个结合相机标定、实例分割、位姿估计和体积计算的端到端计算机视觉系统，可从单张手机照片中估计工业线盘上的电缆剩余长度，在5种线盘类型75次实测中达到4.90%的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE），满足工业界10%的误差容忍标准。

papers.title: LightAIR: Lightweight Action Inversion and Riemannian Rectification for Text-based Person Anomaly Search
papers.authors: Yulun Zhang, Zixu Li, Zhiwei Chen, Zhiheng Fu, Wenbo Wang, Zihang Qiu, Zhilin Wang, Ruxin Wang, Yupeng Hu
papers.affiliations: Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Shandong University
papers.intro: LightAIR通过引入文本语义先验作为锚点、利用正交零空间投影实现前向解耦、并采用黎曼梯度修正切断反向传播中的有害捷径，从而在无外部姿态估计器的情况下显著提升了文本行人异常搜索的性能。
